LanguageData.LP_FeralInstinct.label: feral instinct
LanguageData.LP_FeralInstinct.description: Passive: can't be ambushed, assassinated or caught by surprise (the "unaware" bonuses of sneak attack, assassinate, hide in plain sight and assassination strikes don't work on you). When a raid arrives, act first: for 15 seconds movement ×1.3, aiming time ×0.5, melee cooldown ×0.8. Barbarian level 7 (general).
LanguageData.LP_RecklessCharge.label: rampaging charge
LanguageData.LP_RecklessCharge.description: Charge to an empty cell within 8 cells; enemies along the way take 5 × rage power blunt damage and are knocked down for 2 seconds. Costs 1 rage. Cooldown 20 seconds. Barbarian level 11 (general).
LanguageData.LP_Frenzy.label: frenzy
LanguageData.LP_Frenzy.description: Passive: while raging, resolve an extra normal attack every second against an adjacent enemy you're fighting in melee. Cost: exhausted for 1 hour after the rage ends (movement ×0.8, melee cooldown ×1.2). Path of the Berserker, barbarian level 3.
LanguageData.LP_MindlessRage.label: mindless rage
LanguageData.LP_MindlessRage.description: Passive: while raging, immune to fear, charm and mental breaks (shaken and fear present when the rage starts also disappear). Path of the Berserker, barbarian level 7.
LanguageData.LP_IntimidatingPresence.label: intimidating presence
LanguageData.LP_IntimidatingPresence.description: Glare at an enemy within 10 cells, scaring it into fleeing for 10 seconds (mechanoids and others that can't flee are only shaken). Resist chance = 10% + 2% × target level (up to 50%), 50% for bosses and legendaries. No rage cost. Cooldown 1 hour. Path of the Berserker, barbarian level 11.
LanguageData.LP_Retaliation.label: retaliation
LanguageData.LP_Retaliation.description: Passive: counterattack once immediately when hit by an enemy in melee (at most once per second). Path of the Berserker, barbarian level 15.
LanguageData.LP_TotemSpiritRage.label: totem spirit
LanguageData.LP_TotemSpiritRage.description: Passive, by totem: bear, while raging all damage except psychic ×0.5 (replacing rage's ×0.7); eagle, while raging ranged hits against you ×0.7, movement ×1.2; wolf, while raging allies within 5 cells get melee hit +15%. Path of the Totem Warrior, barbarian level 3.
LanguageData.LP_AspectOfBeast.label: aspect of the beast
LanguageData.LP_AspectOfBeast.description: Passive, by totem: bear, carry capacity ×2; eagle, ranged weapon range +3 and slightly better shooting accuracy; wolf, movement ×1.1, and fleeing enemies within 40 cells are tracked (movement ×0.8). Path of the Totem Warrior, barbarian level 7.
LanguageData.LP_SpiritWalker.label: spirit walker
LanguageData.LP_SpiritWalker.description: Summon spirits of your totem animal to fight for 60 seconds: bear, a grizzly; eagle, two eagle spirits (vanilla has no eagles, so they look like cassowaries); wolf, two timber wolves (three at rage power 125%+). Cooldown 2 hours. Path of the Totem Warrior, barbarian level 11.
LanguageData.LP_TotemAttunement.label: totemic attunement
LanguageData.LP_TotemAttunement.description: By totem: bear, taunt enemies within 8 cells for 10 seconds (they only want to hit you); eagle, glide to an empty cell within 10 cells while raging; wolf, for 20 seconds melee hits knock targets of body size up to 2 down for 2 seconds. For bear and wolf, click any location. Cooldown 20 seconds. Path of the Totem Warrior, barbarian level 15.
LanguageData.LP_StormAura.label: storm aura
LanguageData.LP_StormAura.description: Passive: while raging, every second enemies within radius 3 take (1.5 + 0.1 × barbarian level) × rage power elemental damage (desert burn, sea lightning (EMP for mechanoids), tundra frost). Path of the Storm Herald, barbarian level 3.
LanguageData.LP_StormSoul.label: storm soul
LanguageData.LP_StormSoul.description: Passive: damage of the chosen element ×0.5; desert, max comfortable temperature +40°C; sea, ±20°C at both ends; tundra, min comfortable temperature -40°C. Path of the Storm Herald, barbarian level 7.
LanguageData.LP_ShieldingStorm.label: shielding storm
LanguageData.LP_ShieldingStorm.description: Passive: allies of your side in the storm aura get half of the storm soul (chosen element damage ×0.75, comfortable temperature widened by half). Path of the Storm Herald, barbarian level 11.
LanguageData.LP_RagingStorm.label: raging storm
LanguageData.LP_RagingStorm.description: Passive: storm aura damage ×2, radius 5; each hit has a 25% chance of an added effect (desert ignites, sea stuns 1 second, tundra slows 2 seconds). Path of the Storm Herald, barbarian level 15.
LanguageData.LP_RogueEvasion.label: evasion
LanguageData.LP_RogueEvasion.description: Passive: explosion and area damage ×0.5. Rogue level 7 (general).
LanguageData.LP_SteadyTarget.label: steady target
LanguageData.LP_SteadyTarget.description: Stand and aim for 2 seconds: the next attack within 30 seconds always hits and meets sneak attack conditions. No resource cost. Cooldown 15 seconds. Rogue level 11 (general).
LanguageData.LP_AssassinsOpening.label: assassinate
LanguageData.LP_AssassinsOpening.description: Passive: the first hit against an enemy not yet in combat (no attack target, not hurt and not attacking within 10 seconds) is always a critical (×2) and always a sneak attack. Assassin, rogue level 3.
LanguageData.LP_Impostor.label: infiltration expertise
LanguageData.LP_Impostor.description: Passive: a master of disguise; Shadow Step invisibility lasts ×2. Assassin, rogue level 7.
LanguageData.LP_DeadlyStrike.label: deadly strike
LanguageData.LP_DeadlyStrike.description: Passive: against targets that are downed, asleep, stunned, entangled, in magical sleep or in a mental state (fleeing, charmed, etc.), sneak attacks deal another ×1.5 damage. Assassin, rogue level 11.
LanguageData.LP_DeathStrike.label: death strike
LanguageData.LP_DeathStrike.description: Strike an adjacent enemy for ×3 damage (sneak attack stacks as usual); if the target doesn't fall, it's downed outright unless it resists. Resist chance = 10% + 2% × target level (up to 50%), 50% for bosses and legendaries. Cooldown 6 hours. Assassin, rogue level 15.
LanguageData.LP_FastHands.label: fast hands: pickpocket
LanguageData.LP_FastHands.description: Pick one carried item from an adjacent enemy (medicine first, otherwise the most valuable piece) and put it in your pack. Cooldown 10 seconds. Thief, rogue level 3.
LanguageData.LP_SecondStoryWork.label: second-story work
LanguageData.LP_SecondStoryWork.description: Passive: completely immune to movement slowdown from terrain, snow and plants (stronger than land's stride), movement ×1.15. Thief, rogue level 7.
LanguageData.LP_TreasureSense.label: treasure instinct
LanguageData.LP_TreasureSense.description: Passive: mythal dungeon treasure rooms and guardian rewards each give one extra item (a healing potion). Thief, rogue level 11.
LanguageData.LP_ThiefReflexes.label: thief's reflexes
LanguageData.LP_ThiefReflexes.description: Passive: for the first 10 seconds of each fight (a new fight starts after an hour without attacking or being attacked), melee and shooting cooldowns ×0.5. Thief, rogue level 15.
LanguageData.LP_MageHand.label: mage hand
LanguageData.LP_MageHand.description: An invisible hand: bring an item within 10 cells to your side, or open a door. No mana cost. Cooldown 5 seconds. Arcane Trickster, rogue level 3.
LanguageData.LP_ATMagicMissile.label: magic missile (arcane trickster)
LanguageData.LP_ATMagicMissile.description: Fire 3 arcane missiles, each 4 × cunning power arcane force damage, 28 cells. Costs 1 mana. Arcane Trickster, rogue level 3.
LanguageData.LP_ATInvisibility.label: invisibility (arcane trickster)
LanguageData.LP_ATInvisibility.description: Turn invisible for 20 seconds × cunning power, revealed after attacking (attacking while invisible counts as a sneak attack). Costs 2 mana. Cooldown 20 seconds. Arcane Trickster, rogue level 3.
LanguageData.LP_ATSleep.label: sleep (arcane trickster)
LanguageData.LP_ATSleep.description: Put one enemy within 20 cells into magical sleep for 8 seconds × cunning power. No effect on mechanoids or targets whose consciousness is already below 30%; mind resistance can resist it (-20% resist chance during a magical ambush). Costs 1 mana. Cooldown 1 minute. Arcane Trickster, rogue level 3.
LanguageData.LP_MagicalAmbush.label: magical ambush
LanguageData.LP_MagicalAmbush.description: Passive: sleep cast while invisible lowers the target's resist chance by 20%. Arcane Trickster, rogue level 7.
LanguageData.LP_VersatileTrickster.label: versatile trickster
LanguageData.LP_VersatileTrickster.description: Grab an enemy within 10 cells with mage hand: for 5 seconds it counts as a sneak attack target (anyone hitting it meets sneak attack conditions). No mana cost. Cooldown 15 seconds. Arcane Trickster, rogue level 11.
LanguageData.LP_SpellThief.label: spell thief
LanguageData.LP_SpellThief.description: Passive: when an enemy casts an ability on you (vanilla psycasts, etc.), there's a 35% + mind resistance chance to resist it and steal the spell: you can cast it once within 8 hours. Arcane Trickster, rogue level 15.
LanguageData.LP_FieldEye.label: eye of the wilds
LanguageData.LP_FieldEye.description: Passive: hostile favored enemies on the same map are marked ("spotted"), with a notice the first time. Ranger level 7 (general).
LanguageData.LP_ThornTrap.label: thorn trap
LanguageData.LP_ThornTrap.description: Bury a thorn trap within 15 cells: an enemy stepping on it is entangled for 5 seconds (vine entangle and stun), and it falls apart after triggering once. At most 3 per person; placing another removes the oldest. Cooldown 10 seconds. Ranger level 11 (general).
LanguageData.LP_HuntersPrey.label: hunter's prey
LanguageData.LP_HuntersPrey.description: Passive, choose one: colossus slayer, ×1.25 damage against already-wounded targets; horde breaker, with 3 or more enemies up close, after a melee hit strike another adjacent enemy once more (once per second). Hunter, ranger level 3.
LanguageData.LP_DefensiveTactics.label: defensive tactics
LanguageData.LP_DefensiveTactics.description: Passive, choose one: multiattack defense, from the second hit by the same enemy within 3 seconds, damage ×0.5; escape the horde, explosion and fire damage ×0.5. Hunter, ranger level 7.
LanguageData.LP_MultiAttack.label: multiattack
LanguageData.LP_MultiAttack.description: With a ranged weapon: up to 8 enemies within 12 cells (not beyond range) each take one guaranteed-hit bullet from your current weapon; with a melee weapon: resolve an attack against every adjacent enemy. No resource cost. Cooldown 30 seconds. Hunter, ranger level 11.
LanguageData.LP_SuperiorDefense.label: superior hunter's defense
LanguageData.LP_SuperiorDefense.description: Passive: within 10 seconds after being hurt, taking the same type of damage again deals ×0.5 for that hit. Hunter, ranger level 15.
LanguageData.LP_RangerCompanion.label: ranger's companion
LanguageData.LP_RangerCompanion.description: Passive: use the "choose companion" button to bond with a colony animal (set as its master). The companion's beast level directly follows your adventurer level (up to 40, not limited by the normal master's level 20 growth cap), and it deals +20% damage against your favored enemy. If the companion dies you can choose again. Beast Master, ranger level 3.
LanguageData.LP_ExceptionalTraining.label: exceptional training
LanguageData.LP_ExceptionalTraining.description: Command your companion (within 30 cells): click an enemy → the companion lunges, knocking it down for 2 seconds with a bite; click an ally (or yourself) → companion guard for 30 seconds (that ally takes ×0.75 damage while the companion is within 3 cells); click an item → the companion fetches it back to you. The companion's attacks count as magic weapons. Cooldown 10 seconds. Beast Master, ranger level 7.
LanguageData.LP_BestialFury.label: bestial fury
LanguageData.LP_BestialFury.description: Passive: companion melee cooldown ×0.5 (attacks twice each time). Beast Master, ranger level 11.
LanguageData.LP_ShareSpells.label: share spells
LanguageData.LP_ShareSpells.description: Passive: class buffs you give yourself (rage, hide in plain sight, cunning action and so on) are also applied to your companion within 30 cells; when the companion is downed, it's automatically revived once per day (heals 100). Beast Master, ranger level 15.
LanguageData.LP_DreadAmbusher.label: dread ambusher
LanguageData.LP_DreadAmbusher.description: Passive: your first hit each fight (a new fight starts after an hour without attacking) deals ×1.5 damage and makes the target flee in fear for 3 seconds (bosses and mechanoids are only shaken). While in darkness (light under 30%), melee and ranged hits against you ×0.8. Gloom Stalker, ranger level 3.
LanguageData.LP_IronMind.label: iron mind
LanguageData.LP_IronMind.description: Passive: immune to fear (fleeing mental states, shaken), mind resistance +10%. Gloom Stalker, ranger level 7.
LanguageData.LP_StalkersFlurry.label: stalker's flurry
LanguageData.LP_StalkersFlurry.description: Passive: when an attack misses, follow up with another strike at once (both melee and ranged hits re-roll once on a miss). Gloom Stalker, ranger level 11.
LanguageData.LP_ShadowyDodge.label: shadowy dodge
LanguageData.LP_ShadowyDodge.description: Passive: when attacked by an enemy, 30% chance to dodge the hit completely (at most once every 5 seconds). Gloom Stalker, ranger level 15.
